issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 02 requests only the names and streets of all Freizeitparks and the names of their respective Gemeinden, but the solution query returns an additional column (Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel). This mismatch between the stated required output and the provided solution can confuse students about the exact expected result and violates the instruction to output exactly the requested columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Adjust the solution query to output only the columns requested by the problem statement (Freizeitpark.name, Freizeitpark.strasse, Gemeinde.name) by removing Freizeitpark.gemeindeschluessel from the SELECT clause, or update the problem statement to explicitly include the gemeindeschluessel if that column is intended to be part of the required output.
